Definition: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of a man
BiblicalUsage: 1) flesh; 1a) of the body; 1a1) of humans; 1a2) of animals; 1b) the body itself; 1c) male organ of generation (euphemism); 1d) kindred, blood-relations; 1e) flesh as frail or erring (man against God); 1f) all living things; 1g) animals; 1h) mankind
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
